senses.gloss: m. (חרג) [filling a gap, v. חֲרִיקָא,] step-son.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 3:4">Snh. III, 4</cite> (<cite ref="Sanhedrin 27b">27ᵇ</cite>) (<he>חֹרְגוֹ</he>) <he>חוֹרְגוֹ לבדו</he> his step-son alone (not his relations).
<cite ref="Yevamot 21a:14">Yeb. 21ᵃ</cite>; a. e.—Pl. <he>חוֹרְגִין</he>. Y. ib. II, 3ᵈ bot. <he>שני ח׳ וכ׳</he> two step-children (of different parents) brought up in the same house.
